reasoning: As of March 2026, the SAF recaptured Khartoum in March 2025 after the RSF held it since April 2023. The RSF currently controls most of Darfur but has been pushed back from the capital. For the RSF to retake Khartoum by March 31, 2026 (just 25 days away), they would need to mount a major offensive and defeat SAF forces in sustained urban combat. Given that: (1) the SAF just consolidated control a year ago, (2) no reports suggest imminent RSF offensive toward Khartoum, (3) the RSF is focused on Darfur and el-Fasher, and (4) a 25-day timeframe is extremely short for such a major military operation, the probability is very low. The resolution criteria require sustained control, not temporary incursions.
